class CBubbleStrike {
public:
    double getProb(int x, int n) {
        return 3.0 / 2.0 * x / n * (n - x) / (n - 1) * (n - x - 1) / (n - 2) + 3.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (n - x) / (n - 2) + 1.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (x - 2) / (n - 2);
    }

    void solve() {
        int n;
        double p;
        cin >> n >> p;
        int x = 0;
        while (getProb(x, n) < p) x++;
        cout << x << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    CBubbleStrike solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
